messages:
lee: Postmortem follow-up from yesterday's recurring latency bursts around the 03:xx UTC window. Pattern: cold-cache + small routing imbalance causing p95 spikes and short throughput drops. We need clear owners for remediation, SLO/SLA updates, and monitoring changes. Proposed: leave p50 at 40ms, tighten p95 from 350ms -> 240ms staged, keep p99 unchanged for now. Add a short-term guardrail SLO: 5m sustained p95 degradation > 25% -> trigger page. Also move error-budget alert to a 15m window at 0.8% burn. Claim one of the four items by EOD: (1) SLO edits + customer migration note, (2) dashboards & short-window alerts, (3) runbook + incident playbook, (4) routing/autoscaler fixes + imbalance detector metric.

nina: I'll take (2). Plan: add a 5m p95 rolling panel, a regional heatmap, and an alert rule: `sum(increase(error_budget_burn[15m]))/sum(error_budget_total) > 0.008 -> page eng-sre` (will refine promql). Will also add a small panel that shows fallback activations and reason tags. ETA staging dashboard by Thu.

omar: I'll pick (4). I'll reduce scale-up cooldown, add a zone-weight rebalancer that runs every minute, and emit `imbalance_count` when one zone handles > 1.5x average. Will also add a histogram metric for fallback latency. RFC will be up by Wed.

beth: I'll own (3). Runbook additions: step-by-step to validate cache warmup, quick eviction check, and exact rollback commands for routing policies. Will include decision tree and Pager run checklist. Runbook snippet: 
```
# check recent evictions
curl -s http://metrics/query?query=sum(increase(cache_evictions_total[5m]))\n# quick rollback routing
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://deploy.internal/api/routes/rollback -d '{"reason":"latency-burst"}'
```

lee: I'll do (1). I'll open a draft PR that stages p95 tightening in a canary region for 48h before wider rollout and include a customer-facing note template for Dedicated customers. PR ETA Fri EOD.

nina: A couple of small notes: 1) link dashboard panels to runbook anchors so oncall can jump to steps; 2) surface recent cache miss rates alongside p95 to make triage faster.

omar: Good call. I'll expose `cache_miss_ratio` as a tag on fallback events so we can correlate.

beth: Adding a short checklist item to the runbook for verifying fallback trigger thresholds and confirming rollback readiness.

slo-bot: IncidentBot: postmortem created at 2198005700 -> https://infra/reports/2198005555

lee: Action tracker (due dates):
- lee: SLO PR + migration note  due 2026-04-05
- nina: dashboards + 15m alerts  due 2026-03-31
- beth: runbook + playbook  due 2026-03-30
- omar: autoscaler/routing fixes + RFC  due 2026-04-01
We'll do a coordinated smoke test after staging changes and review at next SLO sync. Ping if you need infra quota or a walkthrough of the dashboard panels.

omar: RFC draft opened -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/rfcs/901. Will link loadtest results here.

nina: Staging dashboard pushed at 2198005740 (dash-staging-v12). Will post link shortly.

beth: Runbook PR coming up in 30m.

lee: Thanks everyone. Aim to keep p99 unchanged for now so we don't over-correct tails while we validate p95 tightening. If any regression appears in canary, we abort rollout and revert SLO PR.
